rp.printHint.zh: 打开浏览器打印对话框，选择“另存为 PDF”。在“更多设置”里关闭“页眉和页脚”，导出的文件不会带上日期和网址。
rp.printHint.en: Opens the browser's print dialog; choose "Save as PDF". Turn off "Headers and footers" under More settings so the file carries no date or URL.

rp.footer.zh: 本报告由 Pulsar Studio 生成。数字均带证据标注（实测 / 推断 / 估算 / 合作方上报），未观测的值显示为不可用，绝不记为零；演示数据均已标注。
rp.footer.en: Generated by Pulsar Studio. Every figure carries its evidence label (observed / inferred / estimated / partner-reported); unobserved values read as unavailable, never zero, and demo data is always labelled.
